lines.t: He called me out, broke my pride, made me new
Exchanged my sight, let me see you with his view
Yo, it's mercy over violence, love over hate
Carred out of darkness, now I'm opening the gate
Truth flows like a river, drowning out my shame
Poured out his life, never played a dead game
His arms wide open, scars still show
Says drop your burden, let my love overflow
Hands up, pride down, surrender's fight
He gave everything, now I'm walking his light
No facade in my eyes, no chains in my heart
Love my neighbors for real, that's the purest
Heart taught me how to walk humble, mercy in my tone
A servant gives low, never sits on his throne
From self to surrender, it's a daily grind
Smashing my idols, I ain't leaving one behind
Now rising to strength, ash is the crown
Living for the king, love spinning around
From the gutter to the throne, I was lost, now I'm found
Gotta let go of me if I'm chasing this crown
True vision in the struggle, gotta learn to forgive
See him with his eyes, that's the way we live
He gave it all, gave love, laid it down
Put me out the mud, set me firm on the ground
Now I love like I'm free, see the world through his eyes
Pride on the altar, let the old ways die
He gave it all, gave love, laid it down
Put me out the mud, set me firm on the ground
Now I love like I'm free
Now I love like I'm free
Now I love like I'm free
